q: The method of variation of parameters solves the inhomogeneous system ẋ = A(t)x + g(t) by seeking a solution of the form x(t) = Φ(t)c(t), where Φ is the fundamental matrix. The result is:
exp: Variation of parameters: differentiating x = Φc and substituting gives Φċ = g, so c(t) = x₀ + ∫₀ᵗ Φ⁻¹(s)g(s)ds. This gives the variation of constants formula—exact solution for any continuous g.
